import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from catboost import CatBoostRegressor
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

train_path = "./input/train.csv"
test_path = "./input/test.csv"

train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)

target_cols = ["formation_energy_ev_natom", "bandgap_energy_ev"]
feature_cols = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in ["id"] + target_cols]

# Automatically detect categorical columns (primarily spacegroup)
cat_features = [
    f for f in feature_cols if train_df[f].dtype == "object" or "space" in f.lower()
]

# Strict 80/20 hold-out split
X_train, X_val, Y_train, Y_val = train_test_split(
    train_df[feature_cols], train_df[target_cols], test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

# Train independent models for each target
models = {}
for i, tgt in enumerate(target_cols):
    model = CatBoostRegressor(
        iterations=400,
        depth=6,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        loss_function="RMSE",
        cat_features=cat_features,
        verbose=0,
        random_seed=42,
        logging_level="Silent",
    )
    model.fit(X_train, Y_train.iloc[:, i])
    models[tgt] = model

# Validate on hold-out set
val_preds = np.column_stack([m.predict(X_val) for m in models.values()])

rmsles = []
for i, tgt in enumerate(target_cols):
    rmsl = np.sqrt(
        np.mean((np.log1p(val_preds[:, i]) - np.log1p(Y_val.iloc[:, i].values)) ** 2)
    )
    rmsles.append(rmsl)

mean_rmsle = np.mean(rmsles)
print(f"Validation Mean Column-wise RMSLE: {mean_rmsle:.6f}")

# Generate and save test predictions
test_preds = np.column_stack(
    [m.predict(test_df[feature_cols]) for m in models.values()]
)

sub_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_df["id"]})
for i, tgt in enumerate(target_cols):
    sub_df[tgt] = test_preds[:, i]

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
sub_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved successfully to ./submission/submission.csv")
